name: vin-detective-ai
description: Research US vehicle VINs from text or photos, locate exact-VIN salvage auctions and damage photos, explain title and recall risks, and estimate used-car offer ranges with evidence.

interface.longDescription: Investigate a US vehicle using a VIN number or photo. Research auction listings, salvage and title information, original accident photos, recalls, reliability concerns and realistic negotiating prices. Cite evidence and distinguish verified facts from unknowns.
defaultPrompt: Investigate this VIN and find original auction photos.
I uploaded a VIN photo. Decode it and check salvage history.
What is a fair buying price for this used car?
